en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Dyad on Accompanied by Rapture (Pītisahagataduka).
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive and accompanied by rapture, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and not accompanied by rapture,
by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive and accompanied by rapture,

there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor with-reactive and not accompanied by rapture, by way of root condition … pe … [dependent on] a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive …

Dependent on a state accompanied by rapture (*pītisahagata*), there arise states that are neither non-visible-and-non-reactive nor accompanied by rapture, and states that are neither non-visible-and-non-reactive nor accompanied by rapture, by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
(Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] for the root, three for the object (*ārammaṇa*) …pe… six for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not accompanied by rapture, there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and is not accompanied by rapture, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [conditions] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
